reason: The monoclinic cell, Z=2, and a plausible average Nd-anion framework are strongly supported by the indexing and high profile correlation, but the exact submitted structure is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the reported correlation is not a standardized fit statistic. More importantly, the trajectory instantiated only one fixed O/F ordering even though O and F are weakly distinguishable with Cu Kalpha diffraction: at the submitted coordinates, placing O on each of the six light-anion sites gives nearly indistinguishable profile correlations of 0.99721-0.99743, with an alternative at 0.99739 versus 0.99743 for the submission. Contact checks do not resolve that discrete ordering ambiguity. The mirror-constrained P21/m model was also not compared against the explicitly acknowledged P21 fallback. Another attempt should explicitly instantiate and jointly refine the plausible O/F orderings and the lower-symmetry model before claiming exact coordinates, ordering, and symmetry.
